thread:
Zoe: uploaded two lightweight onboarding mocks for feedback: 'starter rail' (bottom compact bar) and 'focused modal' (centered). quick takes on UX, a11y, and engineering risk please.
Marco: starter rail wins for low friction. keeps users in flow. modal clearer for step-by-step but blocks context.
Anika: a11y note: rail needs clear focus outlines and an aria-live region for step announcements. ensure contrast for secondary text (current gray is too low).
Zoe: copy ideas: primary CTA 'Try a sample project', secondary 'Browse templates', skip 'Maybe later'. progress label: 'Step 1 of 3'.
Marco: eng estimate: rail ~6-10hrs (sticky component + responsive collapse + analytics); modal ~2 days (focus trap, portal, motion prefs). Modal needs extra QA across browsers.
Anika: analytics: onboarding_shown, onboarding_cta_click (variant, step_id), onboarding_skipped, onboarding_completed. also capture device_type for mobile behavior.
Zoe: product leaning rail for MVP to reduce dropoff. we'll keep modal as an opt-in guided path. plan an A/B to compare completion and time-to-first-call.
DevBot: feature flag created: onboarding.ui_mode (default=rail).
Marco: action items: Zoe finalize copy, Anika publish a11y tokens and run axe on staging, I'll add flag + rollout plan (10% orgs first).
Zoe: thanks — scheduling a short usability pass Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
